records.text: At age 14, Jerri Frantzve lied about her age, altered her birth certificate, and smeared it with Clearasil so she could marry
records.speaker: Jerri L. Frantzve

appearances.snippet: I couldn't face my parents. I loved my boyfriend. We saw an opportunity and we took it. I lied about my age. I altered my birth certificate. I then smeared it with Clearasil to make it look older.
